data.name: Evangelos
data.gender_notes: Evangelos is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek origin, Evangelos translates to 'Bringer of Good News'. This name carries significant biblical and Christian relevance as it is derived from the Greek word 'euangelion', which means 'good news' or 'gospel'. In Christianity, the term 'Evangelion' is used to describe the New Testament narrative of Jesus Christ's life, death, and resurrection.
data.etymology: Evangelos belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evangelos total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אבנגלוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אבנגלוס נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'εὐαγγέλος' (אבנגלוס), שפירושה 'מביא בשורות טובות'. הוא קשור למושג הבשורה הנוצרית, מביא חדשות טובות מאלוהים. השם משקף את הרעיון של הבאת בשורת ישועה והצלה. הוא מופיע בברית החדשה וקשור קשר הדוק לנצרות ולשליחים שהפיצו את בשורת ישוע המשיח.

in_greek.name: Ευάγγελος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ευάγγελος προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'εὐ' (ευ, καλός) και 'αγγέλος' (αγγελος, αγγελος), που σημαίνει 'αγγελιοφόρος' ή 'φορέας καλών ειδήσεων'. Στο πλαίσιο της Καινής Διαθήκης, το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της διάδοσης του Ευαγγελίου ή των καλών ειδήσεων της σωτηρίας μέσω του Ιησού Χριστού. Οι Ευαγγελιστές, δηλαδή οι φορείς του Ευαγγελίου, έπαιξαν κρίσιμο ρόλο στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Evangelos
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Evangelos derivatur a verbis graecis 'εὐ' (bonus) et 'αγγέλος' (nuntius). Significat igitur 'bonum nuntium' seu 'nuntium gaudii'. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen ad Evangelium, i.e., bonum nuntium salutis per Jesum Christum, refertur. Evangelistae, qui primi huius nuntii testes fuerunt, magnam in Ecclesia primitiva habuerunt auctoritatem.

in_english.name: Evangelos
in_english.meaning: Bearer of good news, messenger of divine tidings
in_english.long_meaning: The name Evangelos originates from the Greek words 'εὐ' (good) and 'αγγέλος' (messenger), meaning 'bringer of good news' or 'evangelist'. It is deeply rooted in Christian tradition, symbolizing the spreading of the Gospel or the good news of salvation through Jesus Christ. Historically, evangelists played a pivotal role in the early Christian church by disseminating the teachings and message of Jesus. The name reflects spiritual significance, embodying the virtues of faith, hope, and the proclamation of divine truth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Evangelos holds cultural importance in the Greek Orthodox Church and other Eastern Christian denominations. It is given as a name to celebrate the birth of a child and to reflect the hope and joy of the Gospel message. It also signifies the role of the bearer of the name in spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ to others.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Evangelos holds spiritual significance in the sense that it represents their calling to share the Good News of Jesus Christ with the world. It serves as a reminder of the importance of spreading the Word of God and the role each individual has in bringing salvation to others. It also symbolizes the hope and joy that comes from the Christian faith and the promise of salvation through Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Evangelos, meaning "evangelist" or "bearer of good news" in Greek, symbolizes the spreading of the Gospel message of love, hope, and redemption. It embodies the Christian call to share God's love with others, inspired by the example of Jesus Christ.
